payload.text: TOMORROW, FILE AN ISSUE from another estate's session's note of 2026-10-07: its secret-scan gate (Kingfisher 2.11.0) read the example connection URI in the vendored runtime's helpers (lib/helpers here) as a secret, scanning a repository that carries devbin 0.1.9. It was the one false positive in that repository's whole history, and every estate carrying devbin would need a baseline line for it. Find the URI, drive the scanner on it where it is installed, and give the fix as an example value no scanner reads as a credential. Under directive 13 the next release carries it.
